name: Middle Manager
description: Per my last forecast, please advise.

storm.head: Mandatory all-hands from the sky.
storm.sub: Attendance is required. Lightning is optional. Please work from home.

storm.head: Let's take this offline. Fully offline.
storm.sub: Thunderstorm in progress. Unplug and circle back later.

storm.head: Lightning is out of scope.
storm.sub: We are not resourced to handle this. Remote work approved.

storm.head: The sky escalated to leadership.
storm.sub: Thunderstorm in {city}. Please hold all outdoor meetings.

storm.head: This storm could've been an email.
storm.sub: But here we are. Laptops away from windows.

storm.head: Incident report: sky.
storm.sub: Severity: high. Owner: nobody. Status: stay inside.

storm.head: Severe weather has entered the chat.
Thunder is double-booked with your commute.

snow.head: The sky has unilaterally decided to work from home.
snow.sub: You should too. Roads are a shitshow.

snow.head: Snow is a blocker.
snow.sub: Commute ETA pushed to Q2. Async updates encouraged.

snow.head: We're seeing some headwinds. And flakes.
snow.sub: {temp}. Please be mindful of slippery deliverables.

snow.head: OOO: the roads.
snow.sub: Plows are working on it. Expect delays in all workstreams.

snow.head: Low visibility on the roadmap.
snow.sub: And the actual road. WFH strongly recommended.

rain.head: Per my last forecast: it is raining.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance. Please advise on your umbrella strategy.

rain.head: Quick sync: rain.
rain.sub: Let's align on bringing a jacket going forward.

rain.head: Rain has been added to your calendar.
rain.sub: Recurring. All day. {pop}% chance. No option to decline.

rain.head: Let's put a pin in going outside.
rain.sub: Circle back when the precipitation is deprioritized.

rain.head: Just looping you in: rain.
rain.sub: No action needed. Except an umbrella. That's an action.

rain.head: Rain is now a core competency.
rain.sub: Of the sky. {pop}%. Bring an umbrella.

rain.head: Water-cooler talk is just rain now.
rain.sub: Bring the umbrella so you have something to say.

drizzle.head: Light drizzle. Low-impact, high-annoyance.
drizzle.sub: Not a blocker, but let's flag it.

drizzle.head: Minor drizzle. Non-critical.
drizzle.sub: Logged as low priority. Will not fix.

drizzle.head: Drizzle: technical debt of the sky.

fog.head: Limited visibility into Q4. And the road.
fog.sub: Foggy out. Let's proceed with caution and lower our KPIs.

fog.head: Alignment unclear.
fog.sub: Like everything else this week. Visibility {vis}.

fog.head: We lack clarity on the path forward.
Low-transparency environment.
fog.sub: HR says that's fine. Drive slow.

fog.head: Roadmap foggy, as expected.
fog.sub: Visibility {vis}. Please don't commit to arrival times.

fog.head: Let's not boil the ocean. Or drive fast.
fog.sub: Fog in {city}. Take it slow, team.

windy.head: Strong headwinds this quarter.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Secure your deliverables. And your hat.

windy.head: Pivoting in all directions.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. The wind has no long-term strategy.

windy.head: Disruptive conditions.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Not the good kind of disruption.

windy.head: Please secure loose items.
windy.sub: Lanyards, badges, the patio umbrella. Gusts to {gusts}.

windy.head: High churn outside.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Trash cans have left the organization.

windy.head: Wind: aggressive growth strategy.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Unsustainable, but here we are.

scorching.head: We're running hot today.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Let's take this offline. Offline meaning inside, with AC.

scorching.head: Thermal KPIs exceeded.
scorching.sub: {temp}, feels like {feels}. Exceeding is not always good.

scorching.head: Our sun is overdelivering.
scorching.sub: Please submit sunscreen as a reimbursable expense.

scorching.head: Heat is a top-down initiative.
scorching.sub: Mandatory. Unpopular. Leave the blazer at home.

scorching.head: Heat has been flagged by Facilities.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Please stop opening the loading dock door.

scorching.head: Burnout risk: literal.
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. Take a break in the AC.

hot.head: Let's leverage some shade.
hot.sub: {temp}. Hydration is a core value at this company.

hot.head: Business casual is now business shorts.
Let's keep it cool in here.

freezing.head: Let's circle back when it's above freezing.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. This is fucking unacceptable. Sorry. Per policy.

freezing.head: Hard freeze on hiring. And outside.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Budgets and pipes at risk.

freezing.head: Frozen. Like your raise.
freezing.sub: {temp}. Bundle up. Benefits do not include frostbite.

freezing.head: Cold-start problem.
freezing.sub: Your car, your fingers, your motivation. All of it. {temp}.

freezing.head: Ice: a slippery slope.
freezing.sub: Low of {low}. HR reminds you to hold the handrail.

cold.head: Cold today. Let's touch base on jackets.
cold.sub: High of {high}. That's the stretch goal, people.

cold.head: Temperature below target.
cold.sub: High of {high}. We'll revisit expectations next quarter.

cold.head: Cold outreach from the sky.
cold.sub: {temp}. Unsolicited and unwelcome. Wear a jacket.

cold.head: Brrr-ainstorm session.
cold.sub: High of {high}. All ideas welcome, especially coats.

nice.head: A great opportunity for synergy with the sun.
nice.sub: {temp} and nice. Let's call it a mental health day.

nice.head: Weather is exceeding expectations.
nice.sub: Please don't spend it in a meeting that could've been an email.

nice.head: Weather: crushing it.
nice.sub: Gold star. Exceeds expectations. Promote the sun.

nice.head: Q3 vibes, honestly.
nice.sub: Take your lunch outside. That's an order. A friendly order.

nice.head: The sun is a high performer.
nice.sub: {temp}. Please don't schedule anything over lunch.

nice.head: Let's take this outside.
nice.sub: Not a fight. A meeting. It's {temp} and lovely.

meh.head: A business-as-usual day.
meh.sub: Gray, dull, perfectly adequate. Like the quarterly review.

clearNight.head: It's after hours. Log off.
clearNight.sub: Clear night, {temp}. Nobody's reading your email right now.

clearNight.head: Please disconnect.
clearNight.sub: Clear skies, {temp}. Slack will still be there tomorrow, unfortunately.

clearNight.head: End of day. Truly.
clearNight.sub: Stars are out. Your notifications should be too.

clearNight.head: You're working late again.
clearNight.sub: Close the laptop. The night is clear and so should your schedule be.
